sentence: Two parties need to agree on price and delivery speed for an urgent supply order.

sentence: Teams need to agree on compute tier, storage quota, support level, deployment region, and contract length for multi-year cloud infrastructure.
context: Enterprise cloud procurement negotiation covering five independent dimensions: compute capacity, storage allocation, support entitlement, geographic deployment, and contract commitment.
